#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int mod, k;
    cin >> mod >> k;
    int t = 1, j = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < mod; ++i) {
        t = (long long)t * k % mod;
        if (t == 1) {
            j = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (k == 0) j = 1;
    long long ans = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= (mod - 1) / j; ++i) {
        ans = (ans * mod) % 1000000007;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        ans = (ans * mod) % 1000000007;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
